arguments.sql_query:
WITH ssri AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 21604709
), ssri_eras AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, de.drug_era_start_date, de.drug_era_end_date
  FROM omop.drug_era de
  JOIN ssri s ON de.drug_concept_id = s.drug_concept_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS ssri_era_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS ssri_users
FROM ssri_eras;

WITH ssri AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 21604709
), ssri_eras AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, de.drug_era_start_date, de.drug_era_end_date,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY de.person_id ORDER BY de.drug_era_start_date, de.drug_era_end_date) AS rn
  FROM omop.drug_era de
  JOIN ssri s ON de.drug_concept_id = s.drug_concept_id
), index_eras AS (
  SELECT person_id, drug_era_start_date AS index_date, drug_era_end_date AS index_end_date
  FROM ssri_eras
  WHERE rn = 1
), eligible AS (
  SELECT i.*
  FROM index_eras i
  JOIN omop.observation_period op
    ON op.person_id = i.person_id
   AND i.index_date BETWEEN op.observation_period_start_date AND op.observation_period_end_date
   AND op.observation_period_end_date >= DATEADD(day, 180, i.index_date)
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS new_ssri_users_with_6mo_followup,
  SUM(CASE WHEN index_end_date < DATEADD(day, 180, index_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS discontinued_by_6mo,
  CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN index_end_date < DATEADD(day, 180, index_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL(6,2)) AS discontinuation_percent
FROM eligible;

Among first observed SSRI episodes with at least 6 months of observation after initiation:

- New SSRI users eligible: 99,397
- Discontinued before 6 months: 64,674
- 6-month discontinuation proportion: 65.07%

I defined SSRI exposure using descendants of ATC concept `21604709` (“Selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors”) in `drug_era`, took each patient’s first SSRI era as the index episode, required observation through day 180, and counted discontinuation when the index SSRI era ended before day 180.
